response.rationale: Applicable rules: RET-007 (eligible, priority 10) since within 30 days and not final sale; RET-050 (eligible, priority 50) goodwill grant; and RET-051 (ineligible, priority 50) fraud hold. RET-012 does not apply (final_sale is false), RET-020 does not apply (defective is null), and the electronics rules do not apply (category is apparel). RET-050 and RET-051 tie at the highest priority (50), but the fraud hold is a blocking condition pending review, so the account is ineligible for returns despite the goodwill grant.
